svg.aria-label: A read-only subtitle pipeline over NFS: 1. Token: ExternalSecret bazarr-secret copies PLEX_TOKEN from the 1Password item plex. An empty token still reports synced, so the decoded length is the real check. 2. Start: A busybox init container chowns /run and /tmp. The linuxserver image then runs as UID 2000 with a read-only root filesystem and two emptyDir mounts. 3. Media: Bazarr reads the Plex library over NFS at /data/nas-media and the shared downloads at /data/downloads. 4. Subtitles: It searches subtitle providers through its own settings and writes the matching files beside each media file. 5. Keep: The 5Gi bazarr-config claim, which holds the SQLite database and settings, is backed up by kopiur to Ceph and to R2.
